title: Loop control action
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet. Given an input-head movement, a flag-tape instruction, counter-tape and payload-tape instructions, an optional output bit, and an optional next state in $F$'s state set or a state of the form $(b,(q,c))$ with $b,c\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and $q$ a state of $B$, define an action on $B.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes. The flag instruction is assigned to tape $B.k$, the counter instruction to tape $B.k+1$, and the payload instruction to tape $B.k+1+(1+F.k)$; every other work tape receives no write and no movement. The specified input-head movement, output bit, and next state are used unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Optional write-and-move instruction for the flag tape
